ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels to 35% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions occupy the lateral and distal portions of both lobes; black pigmentation forms a thick, irregular continuous band along the trailing edge and the central fluke area; scattered low-intensity focal spots are distributed across the white fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes ranging from approximately 5 to 20 pixels; distinct peaks and valleys are most prominent on the inner-medial regions of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the main span of the trailing edge, tapering into sharp upward-curving tips (falcate distal ends).

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, high-relief white and grey circular pixels (consistent with barnacles) localized specifically on the distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several thin, dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the white field of the left lobe, oriented diagonally toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle colonization on both distal tips; irregular serrated tissue loss along the trailing edge of the right lobe.
